ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) distal lobes to low-intensity (dark gray/black) central peduncle and medial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigmentation forms a contiguous central 'heart' shape extending from the peduncle. Left lobe: dominant high-intensity white field with a single dark, elongated radial streak located roughly one-third inward from the tip. Right lobe: high-intensity white field heavily disrupted by dense, dark mottling and irregular pixel clusters on the inner medial-distal transition.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees and a depth roughly 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges are largely smooth with negligible pixel amplitude variation; distal tips exhibit high-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude deviations (jaggedness) exceeding 5 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep beginning with a slight convexity near the median notch transitioning into a distinct concavity towards the tapered, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark-intensity pixel clusters localized specifically at the extreme terminal points of both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right distal tip exhibits a jagged, non-linear edge profile and dark-intensity protrusions, indicating localized structural loss or heavy bio-encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry; the right lobe distal field contains high-density dark speckling/mottling that is absent on the corresponding left lobe distal field.
